descripcion.es:
Oportunidad excepcional de adquirir una villa situada en el codiciado barrio residencial de la Milla de Oro de Marbella, a pocos minutos del centro de la ciudad. Una ubicación privilegiada que ofrece una mezcla ideal de vida tranquila. 

La villa se distribuye en tres niveles, con amplias zonas de estar y dormitorios de generosas dimensiones. En la planta principal, un hall de entrada le da la bienvenida, una oficina y un amplio salón que conducen al comedor formal y la cocina, accesible desde el patio, se abre a una terraza y un jardín con piscina privada. 

Convenientemente, también hay una despensa que permite el almacenamiento. Además, esta planta consta de tres dormitorios que comparten un cuarto de baño. Subiendo a la planta superior, le espera un espacio vital más relajado, con impresionantes vistas al mar. Un pasillo permite acceder a otros dos dormitorios que comparten un cuarto de baño. 

Mientras tanto, el ala oeste ofrece una suite principal excepcionalmente espaciosa, con vestidor y baño privado. Completa esta propiedad un sótano con ‌acceso ‌directo ‌al ‌garaje, ‌donde ‌podrá crear ‌su propia ‌zona de ocio, sala de ‌cine ‌o ‌gimnasio. ‌Las ‌posibilidades para convertirla en ‌la ‌casa ‌de ‌sus ‌sueños ‌son ‌infinitas.
descripcion.en:
Villa in a Quiet Urbanisation next to Marbella City Exceptional opportunity to own a villa situated in the highly sought-after residential neighbourhood of Marbella’s Golden Mile, just a few minutes away from Marbella’s City centre. A prime location that provides an ideal blend of serene living. 

The villa is distributed over three levels, featuring expansive living space and generously sized bedrooms. On the main floor, an entrance hall welcomes you, an office and a spacious living room that lead to the formal dining room and the kitchen, accessible from the patio, opens up to a terrace and a garden with a private pool. 

Conveniently, there is also a pantry that allows for storage. Additionally, this floor comprises three bedrooms sharing a bathroom. Ascending to the upper level, a more relaxed living space awaits, offering breathtaking sea views. A corridor leads to two additional bedrooms that share an ensuite bathroom. Meanwhile, the west wing provides an exceptionally spacious master suite, with a dressing room and an ensuite bathroom. 

Completing this property, there is also a basement with direct access to the garage, where you can create your own entertainment area, cinema room, or gym. The possibilities to make it your dream home are endless. Marbella offers the best climate in Europe, modern infrastructure and high-quality amenities as well as a varied choice of golf courses, 5-star hotels, shopping facilities, exclusive nightclubs, restaurants and beautiful beaches. Tourists as well as residents are privileged to enjoy the sunshine ‌and ‌favorable ‌temperatures ‌almost ‌all ‌year round; ‌Marbella having ‌become a renowned worldwide brand ‌as ‌a ‌holiday ‌or ‌a residential destination, with ‌continuous ‌international ‌demand ‌for ‌luxury ‌real ‌estate.
